_comment: Where every picture and font this pack ships comes from (SCHEMA.md section 16). The Cockpit's View Credits lists these under 'Artwork and fonts'; tests/asset_credits.gd fails if a shipped picture or font is missing here. Presentation only - not one of the pack's hashed files.

assets.title: 1941 World map
assets.author: A 1941 Russian political world map, contributed by Sam Kal
assets.changes: Cropped to the map's neat line, 1750 x 1050.

assets.title: Political Map of the World (1941), detail copy
assets.what: The sector windows' theatre plates: the strategic map again, sharper
assets.author: Main Administration of Geodesy and Cartography under the Council of People's Commissars of the USSR (GUGK pri SNK SSSR), with the Central Research Institute of Geodesy, Aerial Survey and Cartography; from the Geographic Atlas for the 5th and 6th Grades of Secondary School, 1941, pages 42-43
assets.licence: Public domain (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0, as Wikimedia Commons marks it)
assets.changes: Aligned to world_1941.jpg (the same atlas scan: SIFT features, a similarity transform, 0.001 degree rotation, scale 2.864), resampled onto its frame at 4096 x 2458, JPEG. Provenance and hashes: look/MAP-DETAIL.md.

assets.title: Western Europe: Political Map (1941)
assets.what: The sector windows' plates for the small European theatres, where the world map is too coarse
assets.author: Main Administration of Geodesy and Cartography under the Council of People's Commissars of the USSR (GUGK pri SNK SSSR); from the Geographic Atlas for the 5th and 6th Grades of Secondary School, 1941, page 14
assets.licence: Public domain (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0, as Wikimedia Commons marks it)
assets.changes: Warped onto the strategic map's frame (a thin-plate spline through 193 anchors matched on coastlines and country fills), cropped to Western and Central Europe, 1197 x 1092, JPEG. Provenance and hashes: look/MAP-DETAIL.md.

assets.title: National flags (1941)
assets.what: The systems' pictures: the flag each flew in 1941 (48 flags)
assets.author: Wikimedia Commons contributors; each file's page, author and SHA-1 are in art/FLAGS.md
assets.licence: Public domain (each file's grounds in art/FLAGS.md)
assets.changes: The PNG Commons renders from each SVG, fitted into 35 x 27 at its own proportions, a little toned to the paper, edged in ink, on a 37 x 37 clear square.

assets.title: Flag: Spain (1938-1945)
assets.what: The picture of the systems that fly it

assets.changes: Commons' PNG rendering, fitted into 35 x 27, a little toned to the paper, edged in ink, on a 37 x 37 clear square. Shared under the same licence.
